name: Converting People
overview: Converting people is centered on the call to repentance and faith in Jesus Christ as the only way to the Father, as Jesus declared Himself to be the way, the truth, and the life (John 14:6). The gospel message invites all to believe in Christ for eternal life (John 3:16) and to respond through repentance and baptism for the remission of sins, receiving the Holy Spirit (Acts 2:38). Believers are commissioned to share this message boldly, yet must also recognize when their witness is rejected and move on without compromise (Matthew 10:14). Scripture warns against being led astray by close relations to serve false gods (Deuteronomy 13:6), underscoring the seriousness of turning people to the true God. Jesus’ own ministry began with the urgent call to repent because the kingdom of heaven is near (Matthew 4:17).
